name: prd-e2e
description: Generate traceable PRD cases and execute them against non-production B2B web systems.

interface.longDescription: Generate traceable cases and a confirmed execution plan from a PRD, compile them without semantic rewriting, and execute them in a non-production B2B web system.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run traceable E2E acceptance from my PRD against a non-production B2B web system.
